entries.c31438fd493328b3: A distinguishing feature is that it acquires information on both lessees and lessors through its daily sales activities, accumulates and updates it daily in the database of a system it developed in-house, and uses it for matching, and that it can provide tenant recruitment, renewal and contract management, and building management consistently within the group.
entries.c4d890177faead40: It is a holding company established in 2000, with its head office in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo. It forms a corporate group with 2 consolidated subsidiaries, and as of June 30, 2026, the number of consolidated employees was 30.

entries.d72d131cfa5f8a90: Targeting commercial real estate, two consolidated subsidiaries run three businesses, the tenant solicitation business, the lease renewal and contract management business and the building management business, and these are disclosed as a single segment.
